plan: Given my value of $25, I aim to bid slightly below it to ensure a profit if I win. The rational strategy is to bid slightly less than my value to cover the potential cost of the second-highest bid. Assuming Betty and Charles also bid rationally, I'll bid around $20 to maximize my expected profit while still having a good chance to win. This way, if I win, I will likely pay less than my value, ensuring a positive profit margin.

Since values are uniformly distributed, bidding slightly above $2 maximizes my chance of winning while ensuring I don't overpay. The other bidders will likely bid close to their values, so a bid close to half my value reduces the risk of overbidding.
